    Open Vacancies

    Join the SESAR Joint Undertaking!

    We regularly post job opportunities on this page for those looking to contribute to the future of European air traffic management. Explore our current openings and consider joining our dynamic team.

    Learn more about our structure and team by viewing the SJU’s Organigramme.

    If you don’t see a vacancy that matches your profile, we welcome spontaneous applications. Please submit your Europass CV in English, along with a motivational letter, to: [email protected].

    For recruitment enquiries, contact us at: [email protected].

    Traineeship

    The SESAR JU actively participates in the European Commission’s Blue Book Traineeship Programme, welcoming trainees twice a year. Our intake aligns with the programme’s calendar, with sessions beginning in March and October. This initiative provides trainees with hands-on experience and the opportunity to contribute to our team’s work.
